answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 33378 Country: India Title: ENGAGEMENT Question: (1) I am working in Saudi Arabia. I am engaged. Can I talk with her. Is it allowed according to Shariah? (2) My friend is also here. He is engaged with his cousin sister. Before he talked her frankly but now he wants to talk her. Is it right or wrong? Answer ID: 33378 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1151/721/L=1432) Until you do not marry your fiancé, she is like a stranger. As it is not lawful to talk to other girls, in the same way it is not lawful to talk frankly to one's fiancé before nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
